name: trains-via-interrupt
title: Trains via Interrupt
author: Dirtyredz
description: Vanilla's 'Trains with this stop' tab only lists stations sitting in a train's schedule, so trains that reach a station through an interrupt are invisible from the station side. This adds a panel beside the train stop GUI with two counts: which trains are wired up to this stop through an interrupt, and which of them want it right now. Parametrised station names are matched, so drop-offs named only by a wildcard are found too.
